subject: general
question:
In the following question, the first and the last parts of the sentence/passage are numbered 1 and 6. The rest of the sentence/passage is split into four parts P, Q, R, and S. These four parts are not given in their proper order. Read the sentence/passage and find the most logical order of the parts between 1 and 6.

Oceans cover more than 70% of Earth's surface. P: Marine species are crucial for food chains. Q: But plastic waste threatens marine life. R: Oceans regulate global temperature and climate. S: They provide food and employment to millions. 6. Ocean conservation must be prioritized.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The passage begins with an introduction to the significance of oceans, highlighting their vast coverage of Earth's surface and their importance in regulating temperature and climate.
 
• **Part R is the first sentence** as it emphasizes the role of oceans in regulating global temperature and climate:
 
 
• "Oceans regulate global temperature and climate."
 
 
 
• **Part S follows** as it elaborates on how oceans support human life:
 
 
• "They provide food and employment to millions."
 
 
 
• **Part P is next** as it highlights the significance of marine species in food chains:
 
 
• "Marine species are crucial for food chains."
 
 
 
• **Part Q is the last** as it introduces the threat posed by plastic waste to marine life, creating a sense of urgency for conservation:
 
 
• "But plastic waste threatens marine life."
 
 
 
• The correct sequence is **RSPQ**.

 

**Coherent paragraph after rearrangement**:

"Oceans cover more than 70% of Earth's surface. Oceans regulate global temperature and climate. They provide food and employment to millions. Marine species are crucial for food chains. But plastic waste threatens marine life. Ocean conservation must be prioritized."
